name: Zombie Train
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombie Train is a free zombie game. Hop aboard the Zombie Train and survive for as long as you can in this 2D, side-scrolling action game. You’re stuck on the Zombie Train, and the only thing to do is stop the zombies before they’re able to stop you. Fortunately, there’s a wide array of items to help you do the job, and the zombies conveniently drop money to help you afford all those items. You’ll get a brief break to collect yourself as the train moves from one station to the next, but ultimately, it’s all zombies all the time.
